title: Qdrant
descript: Qdrant is a vector search engine: store embeddings and find the nearest neighbours in milliseconds, with payload filtering, collections and snapshots. It is the storage layer behind RAG apps and semantic search - point AnythingLLM, Dify or your own code at its HTTP API, and use the built-in dashboard to inspect collections. Runs as a non-root container with data in the application folder.
release_note: 1. First release: Qdrant 1.20.1 (unprivileged image) from Docker Hub as a non-root container. Vector search with REST API and dashboard, data persisted in the application data folder.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). The HTTP API listens on the published port (6333, also serves /dashboard); the gRPC port 6334 is not published. There is NO authentication by default - keep it on your LAN or put an authenticating reverse proxy in front before exposing it. Collections, payloads and snapshots live in DockerAppData/qdrantdocker/storage. Plain HTTP; use TLS for remote access.

zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动安装）。HTTP API 监听已发布端口（6333，同时提供 /dashboard），gRPC 端口 6334 未发布。默认没有任何鉴权——请只在内网使用，暴露到公网前务必加一层带认证的反向代理。集合、payload 与快照保存在 DockerAppData/qdrantdocker/storage。接口为纯 HTTP，远程访问请配 TLS。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首个版本：基于 Docker Hub 的 Qdrant 1.20.1（unprivileged 镜像），以非 root 容器运行。向量检索，提供 REST API 与 dashboard，数据持久化在应用数据目录。

zh-hk.descript: Qdrant 是一個向量檢索引擎：存向量、毫秒級找最近鄰，支援 payload 過濾、集合與快照。它是 RAG 與語義搜尋應用的存儲底座——讓 AnythingLLM、Dify 或你自己的程式碼連它的 HTTP API，內建 dashboard 可以查看集合。以非 root 容器運行，資料保存在應用資料目錄。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。HTTP API 監聽已發佈端口（6333，同時提供 /dashboard），gRPC 端口 6334 未發佈。預設沒有任何鑑權——請只在內網使用，公開到互聯網前務必加一層帶認證的反向代理。集合、payload 與快照保存在 DockerAppData/qdrantdocker/storage。介面為純 HTTP，遠端存取請配 TLS。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：基於 Docker Hub 的 Qdrant 1.20.1（unprivileged 映像），以非 root 容器運行。向量檢索，提供 REST API 與 dashboard，資料持久化在應用資料目錄。

data_notes: `/qdrant/storage` (mounted from `DockerAppData/qdrantdocker/storage`) holds the collections, WAL and snapshots; the dashboard is served at `/dashboard` on the same port.
design_notes: **Unprivileged image variant.** The package uses `qdrant/qdrant:<version>-unprivileged`, which is built to run as uid 1000 - the standard image requires root and panics otherwise.
**One HTTP port.** REST API, dashboard and health endpoint share 6333; gRPC 6334 stays internal.
**API-only by default.** No dashboard auth - the package says so and recommends a proxy.
limitations: - No authentication out of the box; anyone reaching port 6333 can read and write collections.
- Only the HTTP API is published; gRPC clients from other machines need a reverse proxy or a second port, which the store rules do not allow.
- The dashboard is a thin viewer; heavy administration is done through the API or SDKs.
